exercises.prompt: Tell us about a pet you have had or would like to have.
Some people prefer dogs as pets, while others prefer cats. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is considering adopting a small monkey as a pet. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your city is considering banning the sale of dogs and cats in pet stores, allowing adoption only from shelters. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
